subject: POC: Stellar Commerce - Risk tracker / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & POC success criteria (Stellar Commerce)

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed plan for the POC so we have alignment: 

High-level goal:
- Validate Redwood Inference can meet Stellar Commerce's latency and throughput targets for order-extraction and chat-assist flows while preserving PHI isolation requirements.

Success criteria (what Stellar needs to see):
1) Latency: p95 generation < 250ms for chat-assist (avg payload ~ 150 tokens) on dedicated capacity.
2) Throughput: sustained 200 concurrent sessions with <2% error rate for the order-extraction batch workload.
3) Security: keys never leave Stellar VPC; KMS/HSM integration validated for inference.
4) Functional: model outputs pass your validation suite (precision/recall thresholds) on the sample evaluation set.

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 1 (Nov 30—Dec 4): Environment setup — dedicated test pool in your VPC, initial infra + config. Owner: Monica (Solutions Eng).
- Week 2 (Dec 7—11): Integration tests + run evaluation suite with sample dataset. Owner: Rachel (CS).
- Week 3 (Dec 14—18): Scale tests, latency/throughput tuning, and cost estimates. Owner: Marissa (Sales lead).

Immediate next steps (action items):
- Monica to get temporary access to the test bucket + service account (Stellar) — ACTION: Alice to share by Fri (Nov 27).
- Marissa to share the POC_Risk_Tracker and the detailed poc-plan.pdf (attached).
- Rachel to prepare the evaluation checklist and validation scripts.

Escalation path for blocking issues:
- First line: Monica (solutions) -> Rachel (CS)
- If blocker requires engineering: Vivek (Infra/serving lead) -> Redwood on-call/dev (we'll provide SLA for hotfixes).

I've attached the POC_Risk_Tracker.xlsx and poc-plan.pdf for reference. Let me know if you want to tweak the success criteria.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Atts: POC_Risk_Tracker.xlsx (spreadsheet of tracked risks/owners), poc-plan.pdf (detailed schedule)

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and aligns with our expectations. A couple clarifications: 

- For the KMS/HSM requirement, our security team (cc'd) will need a short threat model and an outline of what telemetry Redwood will collect during the POC.
- For the evaluation dataset: we'll provide a masked sample (~2k records) by EOD Friday. Can you confirm that Redwood won't persist raw inputs in hosted logs during the POC?
- On access: I'll share a service account with write ACL to the test bucket (no production keys).

If you can add the security deliverables to the tracker (threat model + telemetry spec) that would help expedite signoff.

Appreciate you moving quickly on this — excited to run the tests.

Best,
Alice

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Johnson <alice@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 14:06:00 -0800
Subject: Blocking integration issue: S3 signed URL + KV cache (logs attached)

Quick update from the integration tests this morning — we hit a reproducible failure when the Stellar pre-signed S3 URLs are rotated during long-running sessions. Symptoms: inference requests intermittently fail with 502 and the runtime loses KV cache entries for affected sessions, which causes output degradation.

Impact: this blocks the Week 2 validation runs (our evaluation scripts depend on stable session KV caching).

What I did so far:
- Collected integration logs and stack traces (attached integration-logs.tgz).
- Reproduced locally with a mocked rotate event — behavior points to a race in our S3 client cache invalidation + KV cache mapping.

Proposed mitigations (short-term):
1) Disable pre-signed URL rotation for POC test bucket (Stellar) until we ship a hotfix. (Owner: Alice/Infrastructure)
2) Patch runtime to rehydrate KV cache on connection re-establish (short-term hotfix candidate). (Owner: Vivek/Infra Eng)
3) As a fallback: route the affected flows to a stateless variant (degraded but functional) and document expected precision loss. (Owner: Rachel/CS)

Requesting escalation: Vivek, can you confirm we have an on-call eng who can triage and estimate turnaround? We should also log this as a Sev-2 POC issue in the tracker so Stellar has clear visibility.

Thanks — attaching integration-logs.tgz and a short repro.
—Monica
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Atts: integration-logs.tgz (logs + repro steps)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alice Johnson <alice@stellarcommerce.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Team <dev@redwoodcommerce.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Blocking integration issue: S3 signed URL + KV cache (logs attached)

Thanks for the clear repro notes, Monica. I've triaged the logs with the on-call infra engineer (assigned: eng-oncall-3) — preliminary root cause looks like a race condition in the S3 client invalidation path that can trigger KV rekeying for an active session.

Immediate plan / owners: 
- On-call eng (eng-oncall-3) to implement a short-term patch that rehydrates KV cache on reconnect and adds a guard around in-flight invalidation. Target: 48—72 hrs for patch + smoke tests. (Owner: eng-oncall-3)
- If patch not ready in 72 hrs, we will toggle the stateless fallback for the affected routes and notify Stellar about expected functional changes. (Owner: Rachel)
- Marissa: I'll update the POC_Risk_Tracker with Sev-2 status, owner assignments, and ETA.

Communication & escalation: 
- I'll schedule a brief 30-min sync tomorrow (Nov 31 — typo: Dec 1) with Monica, the on-call eng, and Stellar infra to validate the repro and share ETA. Monica / Alice — please confirm availability for Dec 1 10:00—10:30 PT or Dec 1 16:00—16:30 UTC.

Thanks — we'll prioritize this and loop you in on status updates in the tracker.

Vivek
VP, Infra & Serving | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Atts: None
